name: Elena north mouth · west corner on Cervantes
about: The raised fan-palm bed up the west side of the Elena north mouth, in front of the CALLE DE ELENA patio wall (lane_walls.json elena-north-corner-patio-wall); its arm along Cervantes is in data/cervantes_lane_edges.json. A rectangle in the Elena north lane frame, built and planted like the Cervantes beds (src/cervantes-lane-edges.ts): s metres along the mapped Elena north centreline from its Cervantes end northwards, o metres off it (negative west, positive east); 'ring' is the same rectangle in model metres. Positions come from the registry house front, the mapped lanes and tile counts in unsolved ground photos, about 0.3-0.5 m; no solved camera sees the corner (photo request elena-north-corner-square).

planters.name: Elena north mouth · raised fan-palm bed under the CALLE DE ELENA wall
planters.basis: The same raised bed turning the corner and running up the west side of the Elena north mouth to the house corner (registry 6265201UF1366N_part4 at -150.01, 48.72), in front of the CALLE DE ELENA wall: frontal in IMG_2800 and IMG_2967, from the mouth in IMG_2514; IMG_2686 shows it at the foot of the view, with a lower bed (not modelled) continuing along the house beyond. Its back is the patio wall on the house-front line (2.24 m west of the centreline). Its lane face is 0.75 m west of the centreline, against the lane paving: IMG_2686 shows the mouth as three 0.4 m tile columns with 0.12-0.13 m margins either side, about 1.45 m, as the structure review found (the first build left a 0.27 m strip at 1.0 m). Estimated to about 0.3 m across, 0.5 m along.
